name: validate_ai_output
description: The merge gate for AI-written CODE: returns a binary approve/reject verdict with veto power. Deterministic reality gates (mock/placeholder veto, gaming and bypass detection, invented-API checks) run first and cannot be overridden; an enterprise review (ISO/IEC 25010) then scores performance, scalability, reliability and tech debt. Call this on every AI-generated diff before you accept it. For plans use validate_plan; for an advisory report without a verdict use analyze_code.

name: validate_plan
description: The gate for PLANS, designs and specs — run BEFORE any code is written. Returns a binary verdict plus findings on completeness, feasibility, performance and scalability implications, security risks, and missing considerations. Use when an AI agent proposes an implementation plan; use validate_ai_output for the code that follows.

name: analyze_code
description: Advisory deep-dive on existing code — scores and findings, deliberately NO pass/fail verdict. Surfaces performance hot paths, scalability cliffs, reliability gaps and tech debt with concrete latency/throughput arithmetic. Use it to understand a validate_ai_output rejection, or to review code you inherited; use validate_ai_output when you need an accept/reject decision.

name: generate_code
description: Generate code and gate it in one step: an LLM writes the implementation, then the same protection engine as validate_ai_output vets it before you see it — no placeholders, no invented APIs, no mock 'success' paths. Use when you want generation with the review already done.
